NAMESPACE.title: The NAMESPACE schema
NAMESPACE.description: The namespace it is going to be deployed.

CLOUD_PUBLIC_HOST.title: The CLOUD_PUBLIC_HOST schema
CLOUD_PUBLIC_HOST.description: PaaS server hostname (Cloud Public host in devops configuration plugin), is used for creating tenant routes.

POSTGRES_HOST.title: The POSTGRES_HOST schema
POSTGRES_HOST.description: Address of PostgreSQL to store databases info.

POSTGRES_PORT.title: The POSTGRES_PORT schema
POSTGRES_PORT.description: Port of PostgreSQL to store databases info.

DBAAS_SECURITY_CONFIGURATION_LOCATION.title: The DBAAS_SECURITY_CONFIGURATION_LOCATION schema
DBAAS_SECURITY_CONFIGURATION_LOCATION.description: Location to save security configuration such as users.

DBAAS_GLOBAL_PERMISSIONS_CONFIGURATION_L.title: The DBAAS_GLOBAL_PERMISSIONS_CONFIGURATION_LOCATION schema
DBAAS_GLOBAL_PERMISSIONS_CONFIGURATION_L.description: Location to save global permissions configuration such as services and their roles.

DBAAS_DEFAULT_PHYSICAL_DATABASES_DISABLE.title: The DBAAS_DEFAULT_PHYSICAL_DATABASES_DISABLED schema
DBAAS_DEFAULT_PHYSICAL_DATABASES_DISABLE.description: Disables usage of the default physical database when no dedicated balancing rules are found for microservice/namespace

REGION_DBAAS.title: The REGION_DBAAS schema
REGION_DBAAS.description: It indicates a node region where pod will be located.

NODE_SELECTOR_DBAAS_KEY.title: The NODE_SELECTOR_DBAAS_KEY schema
NODE_SELECTOR_DBAAS_KEY.description: Specifies a key value of nodeSelector.

USE_POSTGRES_PORT_FORWARD.title: The USE_POSTGRES_PORT_FORWARD schema
USE_POSTGRES_PORT_FORWARD.description: If your deployer has direct access to postgresql database then you should not create and use postgresql port-forward during DBaaS installation.

POSTGRES_DBA_PASSWORD.title: The POSTGRES_DBA_PASSWORD schema
POSTGRES_DBA_PASSWORD.description: Password for postgresql user with SUPERUSER privilege.

POSTGRES_DBAAS_DATABASE_NAME.title: The POSTGRES_DBAAS_DATABASE_NAME schema
POSTGRES_DBAAS_DATABASE_NAME.description: These parameters are needed for connecting to Postgresql physical database where DBaaS will store its own data.

POSTGRES_DBAAS_PASSWORD.title: The POSTGRES_DBAAS_PASSWORD schema
POSTGRES_DBAAS_PASSWORD.description: Password for postgresql user for created database.

DBAAS_RECREATE_DEPLOYMENT_STRATEGY.title: The DBAAS_RECREATE_DEPLOYMENT_STRATEGY schema
DBAAS_RECREATE_DEPLOYMENT_STRATEGY.description: This parameter changes deployment strategy from rolling to recreate.

RUN_DBAAS_SMOKE.title: The RUN_DBAAS_SMOKE schema
RUN_DBAAS_SMOKE.description: Parameters used to set all Autosmoke can be performed during DBaaS deploy.

RUN_SMOKE_POSTGRES.title: The RUN_SMOKE_POSTGRES schema

RUN_SMOKE_MONGO.title: The RUN_SMOKE_MONGO schema
RUN_SMOKE_MONGO.description: Parameters used to set mongo Autosmoke can be performed during DBaaS deploy.

RUN_SMOKE_OPENSEARCH.title: The RUN_SMOKE_OPENSEARCH schema
RUN_SMOKE_OPENSEARCH.description: Parameters used to set opensearch Autosmoke can be performed during DBaaS deploy.

DBAAS_OWN_PG_DB_CREATED_MANUALLY.description: Setting this parameter to true disables automatic database creation by dbaas and allows user to use his own database, username and password which could be created manually.

DBAAS_DB_EDITOR_CREDENTIALS_USERNAME.title: The DBAAS_DB_EDITOR_CREDENTIALS_USERNAME schema

BACKUP_DAEMON_DBAAS_ACCESS_PASSWORD.description: This credentials are for role dbaasbackup.

DISCR_TOOL_USER_PASSWORD.description: This credentials are for role discr_tool_user.

PRODUCTION_MODE.title: The PRODUCTION_MODE schema

DISABLE_DEPRECATED_API.title: The DISABLE_DEPRECATED_API schema
DISABLE_DEPRECATED_API.description: Is deprecated REST API should be disabled

READONLY_CONTAINER_FILE_SYSTEM_ENABLED.title: The READONLY_CONTAINER_FILE_SYSTEM_ENABLED schema

PAAS_VERSION.title: The PAAS_VERSION schema

CLOUD_TOPOLOGIES.description: Array of topologies settings for topologySpreadConstraints. Each array item must contain at least 'topologyKey' attribute. Other supported attributes are 'maxSkew' and 'whenUnsatisfiable' - optional.

DBAAS_BACKUP_RESTORE_CHECK_LOCK_TIMEOUT.title: The DBAAS_BACKUP_RESTORE_CHECK_LOCK_TIMEOUT schema
DBAAS_BACKUP_RESTORE_CHECK_LOCK_TIMEOUT.description: Parameter specifies the default amount of time the lock should be kept in case the executing node dies

DBAAS_BACKUP_RESTORE_CHECK_INTERVAL.title: The DBAAS_BACKUP_RESTORE_CHECK_INTERVAL schema
DBAAS_BACKUP_RESTORE_CHECK_INTERVAL.description: Parameter specifies the period of backup or restore check

DBAAS_BACKUP_RESTORE_CHECK_ATTEMPTS.description: Parameter specifies max number of attempts to check backup or restore

DBAAS_BACKUP_RESTORE_RETRY_DELAY_SECONDS.description: Parameter specifies the delay between retries in seconds

DBAAS_BACKUP_RESTORE_RETRY_ATTEMPTS.title: The DBAAS_BACKUP_RESTORE_RETRY_ATTEMPTS schema
DBAAS_BACKUP_RESTORE_RETRY_ATTEMPTS.description: Parameter specifies max number of retries to check backup or restore

DBAAS_SECURITY_NAMESPACE_ISOLATION_ENABL.title: The DBAAS_SECURITY_NAMESPACE_ISOLATION_ENABLED schema
DBAAS_SECURITY_NAMESPACE_ISOLATION_ENABL.description: Parameter specifies if namespace isolation is enabled. Requests from not valid namespaces will be discarded

M2M_AUTH_MODE.title: The M2M_AUTH_MODE schema
M2M_AUTH_MODE.description: Machine-to-machine authentication mode: legacy, hybrid, or k8s

KUBERNETES_M2M_AUDIENCE.title: The KUBERNETES_M2M_AUDIENCE schema
KUBERNETES_M2M_AUDIENCE.description: Parameter specifies the expected audience from Kubernetes tokens. Tokens with a different audience are rejected

DEPLOYMENT_SESSION_ID.title: The DEPLOYMENT_SESSION_ID schema

MONITORING_ENABLED.title: The MONITORING_ENABLED schema

MANAGED_BY.title: The MANAGED_BY schema
MANAGED_BY.description: Deployer that manages the resources. Rendered as the app.kubernetes.io/managed-by label; the label is omitted when empty.

DEPLOYMENT_STRATEGY_TYPE.title: The DEPLOYMENT_STRATEGY_TYPE schema

ISSUER_GROUP.title: The ISSUER_GROUP schema

ISSUER_KIND.title: The ISSUER_KIND schema
ISSUER_KIND.description: Parameter specifies issuer kind for TLS certificate

ISSUER_NAME.title: The ISSUER_NAME schema
ISSUER_NAME.description: Parameter specifies issuer name for TLS certificate

CERTIFICATE_FILE_PASSWORD.title: The CERTIFICATE_FILE_PASSWORD schema
CERTIFICATE_FILE_PASSWORD.description: Parameter specifies password for certificate keystore file

EXECUTION_MODE.title: Disaster Recovery execution mode
